info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Delete Loan By Param1-spec
info.description: The Manage Loan Products API allows users to efficiently remove loan products identified by specific parameters. This operation is crucial for maintaining an up-to-date and relevant inventory of loan offerings. Typical consumers include financial institutions and lending platforms looking to manage their loan products dynamically. By providing a straightforward method for deletion, this API enhances the overall management of loan resources, ensuring businesses can respond effectively to market changes.

delete.description: This endpoint allows developers to delete a specific loan product identified by its unique ID. Upon successful deletion, the loan product will no longer be available in the system.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to delete the loan product identified by LOAN-500045. Ensure that the request is made with the correct loan product ID to avoid accidental deletions.

204.description: The resource was successfully deleted, and there is no content to return.

DeleteLoanByParam1Request.description: This schema represents the request body for the DELETE operation on loan product LOAN-500045. It is expected to be a string that possibly includes a reason for deletion.

DeleteLoanByParam1Response_204.title: Delete Loan Product Response
DeleteLoanByParam1Response_204.description: Response schema for successful deletion of a loan product, providing metadata about the operation.

ResponseMetadata.title: Response Metadata

bearerAuth.description: Authentication scheme utilizing bearer tokens to provide access control. The tokens should be formatted as JSON Web Tokens (JWT). Ensure that the JWT is included in the Authorization header of the request.
